name: HyperX Alloy Elite RGB
notes: 65-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface of a real HyperX Alloy Elite RGB, from a libinput record of the device on Linux: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/uploads/f75428d796ad4bc327a82b9c0055bc90/recording.yml.2021-05-18-04_12_02. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
